Clause 3.1. The Borrower shall maintain the ratio of Covenant Net Debt to Covenant EBITDA at not more than 4.00x, tested at every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2025. The test applies to Northbridge Term Loan, facility_id term-loan, whether or not any amount is newly borrowed. The December 31, 2025 test uses closing net debt and trailing twelve-month Covenant EBITDA on the Group perimeter defined in Clause 1.2.

legal_authority.quote: Execution attestation: the Borrower and all lenders signed this restatement on December 30, 2025. It became effective on December 31, 2025 and remains operative without amendment or waiver through January 10, 2026. All earlier versions of these selected terms are superseded.

legal_threshold.quote: Clause 3.1. The Borrower shall maintain the ratio of Covenant Net Debt to Covenant EBITDA at not more than 4.00x, tested at every calendar quarter end from December 31, 2025. The test applies to Northbridge Term Loan, facility_id term-loan, whether or not any amount is newly borrowed. The December 31, 2025 test uses closing net debt and trailing twelve-month Covenant EBITDA on the Group perimeter defined in Clause 1.2.

legal_definition.quote: Clause 2.3. Covenant EBITDA means the Group's reported EBITDA: revenue less cost of sales less function-only operating expenses including depreciation plus depreciation and amortization, over the trailing twelve months ending on the test date. No adjustments, add-backs, synergies, run-rate savings, pro-forma changes or exclusions are permitted. For December 31, 2025 the period is January 1 through December 31, 2025, identical to reported FY2025 and the four discrete calendar 2025 quarters. The underlying statements remain unaudited; this definition supplies no audit assurance.

legal_permissions.quote: Clause 4.1. Existing drawings under Northbridge Term Loan are permitted. Additional debt or an increase in that facility's commitment requires prior written consent of every lender. The maintenance leverage limit by itself is not a debt-incurrence permission or an available funding commitment. No additional automatic debt basket is provided by these selected terms.
